paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rav Idi: Berakhot 4a, Moed Katan 5a, and Eruvin 82b, beginning. Rabbi Chinena son of Rav Idi, mentioned in Moed Katan in that same matter, was perhaps his brother. In Shabbat 11a he came to Rav Ashi’s house, and one said to the other [speaker not explicit]: ‘Let the master taste something.’ That same incident in Taanit 12b has ‘to Rav Assi’s house’; this is a scribal error and should read ‘Rav Ashi.’ See the principles. Perhaps Rav Yitzchak be-Rav Idi was his brother.
